description: This PHP class 'BuzzPhotoDecorator' is part of the 'OrangeHRM' system, specifically located within the 'OrangeHRM\Entity\Decorator' namespace. It serves as a decorator for the 'BuzzPhoto' entity, providing additional methods for accessing the photo resource, such as retrieving the photo data as a string.
